title: A shout-out to Chris Moyer, the Rowlett mentor who makes the city shine
excerpt: A fellow business owner says Chris Moyer helped him grow his business this year, and that his work for the community and the Rowlett Chamber makes him a special neighbor.
body:
Some of the best good news in Rowlett is about people who quietly lift up the people around them. This week, a reader wrote in to say thank you to one of them: Chris Moyer.

The reader, a local business owner, says Chris helped him grow his business this year, one business owner to another. That kind of help, given freely to someone just starting out, is how small businesses in a town like ours get stronger together.

But it isn't only about business. Chris gives his time to countless efforts in the community and to the Rowlett Area Chamber, and that's what makes him such a special citizen of Rowlett, the reader says.

"I am honored to have him as a friend and mentor in my life," he wrote. "He makes Rowlett shine a little more than it already does!"

If Chris has helped you too, or you've seen him at a Chamber event, take a minute this week to tell him thanks. And if there's someone in Rowlett who has made a difference for you, we'd love to hear about them.
